currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Pin one complete interpretation and profile
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Define the exact specification objects consumed by run: governing source/import closure, closed schema, source/hash-profile registry, signature-policy predicate, trust/revision/private-resolution policy, bounds and lifecycle semantics. Prove all references resolve uniquely to these pinned objects.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Recover and verify exact intended Lean dependency closure
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Hash-bind every imported source/compiled module, Std/compiler version and axiom audit to the exact proof target; compile the whole graph at trust0; match all declared theorem names to audits; prove final witnesses are from this graph.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Actual strict intake and closed schema
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Prove actual parseStrict/validate soundness and completeness for UTF8, decoded Unicode, duplicate detection before discard, exact nested key sets/types, source-order constraints, revision bounds, predecessor/null rules, approved identifiers and stated limits.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Preserve all eight semantic findings
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Specify and prove attribution-map validity separately from schema validity, then define a proved mapping from the concrete eight-finding decision record to any abstract gate model; prove no required finding is dropped or silently folded.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Concrete ordered-pair recovery and association
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: For actual source A/B input and record construction, prove the source order, identifiers and commitment/attribution fields refer to the same ordered pair. Use an order-preserving representation; prove exact roundtrip/canonical accepted-wire converse.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Exact canonical record bytes
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Instantiate the actual record codec and prove C=UTF8(JCS(payload)) exactly, canonical roundtrip and uniqueness on allowed payloads, UTF16 key ordering, array/string preservation, number behavior and absence of BOM/trailing newline.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Exact pure-Ed25519 signed message
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Prove M=ASCII(NUMINA-PAIR-BINDING/V1)||0x00||C, with the22ASCII-byte literal plus one separator, no extra bytes and pure Ed25519 rather than application prehash/Ed25519ctx.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Verification acceptance predicate and implementation correspondence
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Define exact raw-key/signature decoding, canonical scalar/point rules, small-order/subgroup/cofactor handling and signature equation; prove concrete provider/native verifier returns true iff the selected mathematical predicate holds on the exact M.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Independent key, role and scope authorization
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Prove accepted key_id matches the raw-key fingerprint under the selected profile and the authenticated trust entry permits exact project/release/source/role at the selected validity/revocation times; reject out-of-scope keys even with valid signatures.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Source reproduction and current equality
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Prove selected historical normalization/hash computations operate on exact resolved artifacts, compare both ordered commitments, and keep current canonical-source equality as a distinct predicate backed by independently authenticated immutable identity.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Authenticated revision/replay/conflict lifecycle
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Instantiate current-state authority and transition system; prove predecessor links, monotonic update rules, revocation, same-revision conflict preservation, cache-age rules and stale/rollback/fork rejection; acceptance requires authenticated current binding/revision/payload digest.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Authorized private mapping semantics
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Prove permitted opaque references resolve only through an authenticated authorized mapping/version and missing/denied evidence remains unverified; public input cannot choose arbitrary resolver locations.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Structured verdicts, closure and failure dominance
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Prove null signature yields unsigned pending, malformed/failing signature yields invalid, diagnostic findings remain distinct, failure dominates and unavailable/pending/blocked/crashed/incomplete never yields signed acceptance; every mandatory closure stage is Finished(Pass) for the pinned target.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Actual executable/state refinement and source-to-binary linkage
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Construct a refinement/conformance witness for the exact implementation and build; prove wire intake, validation, message construction, cryptography, evidence resolution and decision output agree with the exact specification, and resource failures preserve incomplete outcomes.

currentWholeProtocolObligations.title: Field deployment and reality correspondence
currentWholeProtocolObligations.preciseGoal: Obtain exact deployed source/build/environment/operator identities, actually accepted companion bytes, independent trust/current-state/resolver outputs, observed usage and revocation/recovery/failure receipts for a declared interval.
